mapper.select: /* selectMasterMdCtReportSalesPopList */ SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(XX.TOTAL_MONTH, 'YYYYMM'),'YYYY/MM') AS TOTAL_MONTH_YYYYMM , XX.BUYER , (SELECT CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = XX.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME , NVL(MAX(XX.LAST_YEAR_AMT),0) AS LAST_YEAR_AMT , NVL(MAX(XX.LAST_MONTH_AMT),0) AS LAST_MONTH_AMT , NVL(MAX(XX.THAT_MONTH_AMT),0) AS THAT_MONTH_AMT , XX.TOTAL_MONTH AS TOTAL_MONTH FROM ( SELECT #{st_close_month} AS TOTAL_MONTH , A.GROUP_CODE , A.GROUP_NAME , A.BUYER , SUM(A.RESULT_AMT) AS LAST_YEAR_AMT , 0 AS LAST_MONTH_AMT , 0 AS THAT_MONTH_AMT FROM KEP_REPORT_TOTAL A WHERE A.GROUP_CODE = #{st_group_code} AND A.TOTAL_MONTH= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{st_close_month},'YYYYMM'),-12),'YYYYMM') AND A.CREATE_FLAG = 'A' GROUP BY A.TOTAL_MONTH , A.GROUP_CODE , A.GROUP_NAME , A.BUYER UNION ALL SELECT #{st_close_month} AS TOTAL_MONTH , A.GROUP_CODE , A.GROUP_NAME , A.BUYER , 0 AS LAST_YEAR_AMT , SUM(A.RESULT_AMT) AS LAST_MONTH_AMT , 0 AS THAT_MONTH_AMT FROM KEP_REPORT_TOTAL A WHERE A.GROUP_CODE = #{st_group_code} AND A.TOTAL_MONTH= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{st_close_month},'YYYYMM'),-1),'YYYYMM') AND A.CREATE_FLAG = 'A' GROUP BY A.TOTAL_MONTH , A.GROUP_CODE , A.GROUP_NAME , A.BUYER UNION ALL SELECT A.TOTAL_MONTH , A.GROUP_CODE , A.GROUP_NAME , A.BUYER , 0 AS LAST_YEAR_AMT , 0 AS LAST_MONTH_AMT , SUM(A.RESULT_AMT) AS THAT_MONTH_AMT FROM KEP_REPORT_TOTAL A WHERE A.GROUP_CODE = #{st_group_code} AND A.TOTAL_MONTH= #{st_close_month} AND A.CREATE_FLAG = 'A' GROUP BY A.TOTAL_MONTH , A.GROUP_CODE , A.GROUP_NAME , A.BUYER ) XX GROUP BY XX.TOTAL_MONTH , XX.BUYER

/* selectMasterMdCtReportSalesPopDeptList */ SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(XX.TOTAL_MONTH, 'YYYYMM'),'YYYY/MM') AS TOTAL_MONTH_YYYYMM , XX.BUYER , XX.DEPARTMENT , (SELECT COD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 COD WHERE COD.TYPE ='C001' AND COD.COMPANY_CODE =XX.BUYER AND COD.CODE = XX.DEPARTMENT) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME , (SELECT CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = XX.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME , NVL(MAX(XX.LAST_YEAR_AMT),0) AS LAST_YEAR_AMT , NVL(MAX(XX.LAST_MONTH_AMT),0) AS LAST_MONTH_AMT , NVL(MAX(XX.THAT_MONTH_AMT),0) AS THAT_MONTH_AMT , XX.TOTAL_MONTH AS TOTAL_MONTH FROM ( SELECT #{st_close_month} AS TOTAL_MONTH , A.GROUP_CODE , A.GROUP_NAME , A.BUYER , A.DEPARTMENT , SUM(A.RESULT_AMT) AS LAST_YEAR_AMT , 0 AS LAST_MONTH_AMT , 0 AS THAT_MONTH_AMT FROM KEP_REPORT_TOTAL A WHERE A.GROUP_CODE = #{st_group_code} AND A.TOTAL_MONTH= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{st_close_month},'YYYYMM'),-12),'YYYYMM') AND A.CREATE_FLAG = 'A' GROUP BY A.TOTAL_MONTH , A.GROUP_CODE , A.GROUP_NAME , A.BUYER , A.DEPARTMENT UNION ALL SELECT #{st_close_month} AS TOTAL_MONTH , A.GROUP_CODE , A.GROUP_NAME , A.BUYER , A.DEPARTMENT , 0 AS LAST_YEAR_AMT , SUM(A.RESULT_AMT) AS LAST_MONTH_AMT , 0 AS THAT_MONTH_AMT FROM KEP_REPORT_TOTAL A WHERE A.GROUP_CODE = #{st_group_code} AND A.TOTAL_MONTH= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{st_close_month},'YYYYMM'),-1),'YYYYMM') AND A.CREATE_FLAG = 'A' GROUP BY A.TOTAL_MONTH , A.GROUP_CODE , A.GROUP_NAME , A.BUYER , A.DEPARTMENT UNION ALL SELECT A.TOTAL_MONTH , A.GROUP_CODE , A.GROUP_NAME , A.BUYER , A.DEPARTMENT , 0 AS LAST_YEAR_AMT , 0 AS LAST_MONTH_AMT , SUM(A.RESULT_AMT) AS THAT_MONTH_AMT FROM KEP_REPORT_TOTAL A WHERE A.GROUP_CODE = #{st_group_code} AND A.TOTAL_MONTH= #{st_close_month} AND A.CREATE_FLAG = 'A' GROUP BY A.TOTAL_MONTH , A.GROUP_CODE , A.GROUP_NAME , A.BUYER , A.DEPARTMENT ) XX GROUP BY XX.TOTAL_MONTH , XX.BUYER , XX.DEPARTMENT

/* selectMasterMdCtReportSalesTotalList */ SELECT A.TOTAL_MONTH , A.GROUP_CODE , A.GROUP_NAME , A.CREATE_FLAG , A.BUYER AS COM_CODE , (SELECT CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = A.BUYER) AS COM_NAME , A.DEPARTMENT AS DEPT_CODE , (SELECT COD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 COD WHERE COD.TYPE ='C001' AND COD.COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND COD.CODE = A.DEPARTMENT) AS DEPT_NAME , A.RESULT_AMT AS AR_AMT , A.ADD_DATE FROM KEP_REPORT_TOTAL A WHERE A.GROUP_CODE = #{st_group_code} AND A.TOTAL_MONTH= #{st_close_month} AND A.CREATE_FLAG = 'M'

/* selectMasterMdCtReportSalesNewPop */ SELECT XX.TOTAL_MONTH , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(XX.TOTAL_MONTH, 'YYYYMM'),'YYYY/MM') AS TOTAL_MONTH_YYYYMM , XX.GROUP_CODE , XX.GROUP_NAME , XX.CREATE_FLAG , XX.TYPE , NVL(MAX(XX.LAST_YEAR_CNT),0) AS LAST_YEAR_CNT , NVL(MAX(XX.LAST_YEAR_AMT),0) AS LAST_YEAR_AMT , NVL(MAX(XX.LAST_MONTH_CNT),0) AS LAST_MONTH_CNT , NVL(MAX(XX.LAST_MONTH_AMT),0) AS LAST_MONTH_AMT , NVL(MAX(XX.THAT_MONTH_CNT),0) AS THAT_MONTH_CNT , NVL(MAX(XX.THAT_MONTH_AMT),0) AS THAT_MONTH_AMT FROM ( SELECT #{st_close_month} AS TOTAL_MONTH , A.GROUP_CODE , A.GROUP_NAME , A.CREATE_FLAG , A.TYPE , A.TOTAL_CNT AS LAST_YEAR_CNT , A.TOTAL_AMT AS LAST_YEAR_AMT , 0 AS LAST_MONTH_CNT , 0 AS LAST_MONTH_AMT , 0 AS THAT_MONTH_CNT , 0 AS THAT_MONTH_AMT FROM KEP_REPORT_TOTAL_NEW A WHERE SUBSTR(A.TOTAL_MONTH,0,4) LIKE SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{st_close_month},'YYYYMM'),-12),'YYYYMM'),0,4)||'%' AND A.GROUP_CODE = #{st_group_code} AND A.CREATE_FLAG = 'A' UNION ALL SELECT #{st_close_month} AS TOTAL_MONTH , A.GROUP_CODE , A.GROUP_NAME , A.CREATE_FLAG , A.TYPE , 0 AS LAST_YEAR_CNT , 0 AS LAST_YEAR_AMT , A.TOTAL_CNT AS LAST_MONTH_CNT , A.TOTAL_AMT AS LAST_MONTH_AMT , 0 AS THAT_MONTH_CNT , 0 AS THAT_MONTH_AMT FROM KEP_REPORT_TOTAL_NEW A WHERE A.TOTAL_MONTH = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{st_close_month},'YYYYMM'),-1),'YYYYMM') AND A.GROUP_CODE = #{st_group_code} AND A.CREATE_FLAG = 'A' UNION ALL SELECT A.TOTAL_MONTH , A.GROUP_CODE , A.GROUP_NAME , A.CREATE_FLAG , A.TYPE , 0 AS LAST_YEAR_CNT , 0 AS LAST_YEAR_AMT , 0 AS LAST_MONTH_CNT , 0 AS LAST_MONTH_AMT , A.TOTAL_CNT AS THAT_MONTH_CNT , A.TOTAL_AMT AS THAT_MONTH_AMT FROM KEP_REPORT_TOTAL_NEW A WHERE A.TOTAL_MONTH = #{st_close_month} AND A.GROUP_CODE = #{st_group_code} AND A.CREATE_FLAG = 'A' ) XX GROUP BY XX.TOTAL_MONTH , XX.GROUP_CODE , XX.GROUP_NAME , XX.CREATE_FLAG , XX.TYPE

/* selectMasterMdCtReportSalesNewInputPop */ SELECT A.TOTAL_MONTH , A.GROUP_CODE , A.GROUP_NAME , A.CREATE_FLAG , A.TYPE , A.TOTAL_CNT , A.TOTAL_AMT FROM KEP_REPORT_TOTAL_NEW A WHERE A.TOTAL_MONTH = #{st_close_month} AND A.GROUP_CODE = #{st_group_code} AND A.CREATE_FLAG = 'M' ORDER BY A.TYPE

A.RD_STATUS = CASE WHEN A.RD_YN = 'Y' AND A.RD_TYPE = 'M' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEP_REPORT_TOTAL_SG WHERE GROUP_CODE = A.GROUP_CODE AND TOTAL_MONTH = A.CLOSE_MONTH AND CREATE_FLAG = 'M') = 0 THEN AND CREATE_FLAG = 'M') = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE A.RE_CD_STATUS END, A.RE_WD_STATUS = CASE WHEN A.RE_WD_YN = 'Y' AND A.RE_WD_TYPE = 'M' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEP_REPORT_RE WHERE GROUP_CODE = A.GROUP_CODE AND TOTAL_MONTH = A.CLOSE_MONTH AND CREATE_TYPE = 'W' AND CREATE_FLAG = 'M') = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE A.RE_WD_STATUS END, A.EVALUATION_STATUS = CASE WHEN A.EVALUATION_YN = 'Y' AND (A.EVALUATION_TITLE_1 = '' OR A.EVALUATION_TITLE_1 IS NULL) AND (A.EVALUATION_TITLE_2 = '' OR A.EVALUATION_TITLE_2 IS NULL) THEN 'N' ELSE A.EVALUATION_STATUS END, A.PD_STATUS = CASE WHEN A.PD_YN = 'Y' AND A.PD_TYPE = 'M' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEP_REPORT_TOTAL_SG WHERE GROUP_CODE = A.GROUP_CODE AND TOTAL_MONTH = A.CLOSE_MONTH AND CREATE_FLAG = 'M') = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE A.PD_STATUS END, A.BUYER_CA_PD_STATUS = CASE WHEN A.BUYER_CA_PD_YN = 'Y' AND A.BUYER_CA_PD_TYPE = 'M' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEP_REPORT_TOTAL_SG WHERE GROUP_CODE = A.GROUP_CODE AND TOTAL_MONTH = A.CLOSE_MONTH AND CREATE_FLAG = 'M') = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE A.BUYER_CA_PD_STATUS END, CHANGE_DATE= SYSDATE, CHANGE_USER_ID = #{st_user_id} WHERE 1=1 AND A.REPORT_NO = #{st_report_no}
